newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil authorizes 1.0 bln mark debt issue.
newsitem.headline: Brazil authorizes 1.0 bln mark debt issue.

text.p: The Brazilian Finance Ministry Wednesday published a decree authorizing the National Treasury to raise about 1.0 billion marks on German debt markets, officials said.
The decree published in the government's Official Journal said the issue would be lead managed by Credit Suisse First Boston AG.
It gave no dates for the issue and no officials were immediately available to comment.
Brazil last month launched a 500 million mark bond that was so well received the Central Bank doubled the issue the next day.
The decree published Wednesday said the new issue was aimed at replacing domestic debt with external debt and said the operation had been authorized by the Senate in 1995.
